evidence.quote: a third full is less than a day of stock on a Friday

observations.why: Enacts a stated allocation rule by directive ('stays', 'now restock at half full'), so authority-ranking leads; the justification weighs consequence against proportion (a third full vs. a day of stock), which is market-pricing. Torn between the two; the directive is the primary move and the proportional reasoning is secondary. Split footing (claude-opus-5-5 animates, Tina TeamMember is principal), so the stance is the principal's as presented.
